WITH per_site AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneref,
    si.entrystat,
    AVG(s.memusagegb) AS avg_ram,
    AVG(s.procgpu::numeric / NULLIF(s.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio
  FROM scanprocessing AS s
  JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  WHERE s.memusagegb >= 60.8
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.entrystat
)
SELECT
  entrystat,
  AVG(avg_ram) AS avg_site_ram,
  AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_site_gpu_cpu_ratio
FROM per_site
GROUP BY entrystat;
